comment_content:
While curiosity and communication got decent attention. The need for
creativity for a DS is often under estimated. I keep saying this.. A Data
Scientist without creativity is unquenchable. A data scientist with creativity
is unstoppable. The reason is if a DS doesnt have a creative mind, at every
problem he asks others/google those questions or ideas to tackle those
problems. So his questions cannot be quenched. The DS with creativity doesnt
have time to execute all ideas he get on feature engineering. So even at 10 Pm
on sunday night, he keeps working on models/insights. Hence un stoppable.
